text:
ryan: FYI customer 'atlas-vision' reports a ~20% embed undercount across a multi-region rate cap enforcement window last week. They say their dashboard shows 52k embeds but our billed export has ~41k.

billing-bot: automated alert: reconcile-delta detected for customer atlas-vision 2025-08-03 to 2025-08-03, delta -20.1% (10,440 embeds). Ticket FIN-9901 opened.

claire-fin: pulling the numbers now. If true this could be ~$4.98 at $0.00048/embed but because customer is on Dedicated reserved capacity there are contractual nuances for overage and credits.

min: infra timeline: we had coordinated rate-cap enforcement in us-west and eu-central at 09:00 UTC to protect shared pools. Short summary: throttles returned HTTP 429 with a fast-fail policy; clients using sync SDKs didn't retry for several seconds and some batches never reached ingest-ack.
evansre: I captured a shard-level snapshot: about 10,440 embed events from atlas-vision show ack_status='dropped' between 09:02-09:11 UTC due to enforced client-side backoff + region steering.

ryan: customer concern: they use bursts and expect Dedicated to cover capacity. If we undercount due to our throttle, they want either a backfill (restore ledger) or an overage forgiveness for those bursts.

claire-fin: finance options: 1) Ledger backfill: re-ingest raw events and update ledger -> changes historic billed units and requires audit trail + legal signoff for contract-modifying actions. 2) Manual credit: simpler, posts a non-invoice-affecting adjustment and note. 3) Waive/forgive overage charges for the window as a customer experience gesture.

min: technical risk: re-ingesting into live billing ledger requires dedupe checks and a safe idempotency window; we've not run a multi-region backfill of this size on Dedicated before. Potentially high-risk for duplication or race with live writes.

claire-fin: quantify options: backfill delta = 10,440 embeds -> $5.01. Forgiveness = waive any overage fees if they were charged (we need to check reserved capacity usage vs commit). Manual credit same dollar impact but simpler to audit.

vp-finance: tagging in. For small-dollar deltas I generally prefer manual credit plus an ops remediation plan rather than ledger surgery. Legal only needs to be looped for invoice-affecting changes above $1k or contract amendments.

ryan: customer is sensitive to correct telemetry for their internal reporting; they'd prefer ledger restoration if possible so their graphs align. But they also want resolution fast.

evansre: mitigation path: 1) snapshot raw event segments (done) 2) run a sandbox replayer to validate idempotency and dedupe behavior (estimated 1 business day) 3) if safe, we can run a controlled backfill into a backfill namespace and generate reconciliation artifacts for their internal metrics (not touching invoices) 4) independent manual credit to make them whole on billing.

claire-fin: proposed course: issue manual credit now to avoid billing disputes, mark credit FIN-9902 for $5.01, and start the sandbox replay path. If replay validates, offer to import the replayed counts into their metrics dashboards (not the invoice) so their telemetry matches. That satisfies both billing and telemetry without risky ledger edits.

min: I'll kick off sandbox replay and a dedupe audit. ETA: 18-24 hours.

vp-finance: approved: manual credit + replay + metrics-only import if validated. Finance will not alter issued invoices. Loop legal only if replay suggests we must change an invoice > $1k.

ryan: will message the customer: apologize, issue credit, share expected timeline for telemetry reconciliation and replay report.

billing-bot: credit FIN-9902 queued: $5.01 for atlas-vision.

claire-fin: I'll prepare the credit and the invoice memo: "Manual credit for embed undercount during multi-region rate-cap enforcement on 2025-08-03. Replay in progress for telemetry reconciliation."

min: saving replay artifacts to s3://forensics/atlas-vision/2025-08-03-ratecap-replay.tar.gz and will attach reconciliation CSV when ready.

ryan: customer notified and account team looped. Closing finance thread; monitoring for customer response.

claire-fin: credit applied and note recorded. Follow-up: include rate-cap failback and ACK persistence changes in the next SRE runbook.

vp-finance: thanks all. Please include postmortem in incidents and attach audit rows to FIN-9901. Closing thread.
